items.caption: Spatial 3D map of the entire NRG-Stack federation: the inverter at the center, all device categories (PV, battery, grid, house consumption, consumers, wallbox, vehicle) arranged radially around it. All devices are found automatically through the installed partner modules - no manual configuration needed.

Categories with several instances (e.g. two grid meters or two wallboxes) appear as a collective node with the individual instances fanned out locally around it - this keeps the map clear no matter how many meters are added. All MeterHub meters/functions automatically appear as a node of their own, even with several meters of the same category.
Drag with the mouse to rotate (with a gentle ease-out), use the mouse wheel to zoom.

✨ Detail (start the tour yourself at any time, 01.09.2026): a clearly visible “?” button at the bottom left of the tile shows the introduction tour again at any time - regardless of the saved “already seen” status. Intended for shared instances (e.g. a demo/showcase instance with one shared login for all visitors).
Optional - detected automatically when exactly one InverterHub instance is installed. Only choose one here if there are several instances.
